summary_1line: Narada cites the mighty kings Sivi and Rama—renowned for generosity, conquest, and righteous rule—yet both died, urging Srinjaya not to mourn his lesser son.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Sivi’s vast sacrifice gleams with golden altars and arches while crowds of Brahmanas gather beside lakes of milk and hills of food.
Rama stands in battle drawing his bow against Ravana amid a storm of weapons as the demon king and his hosts fall around him.
In Rama’s kingdom peaceful people thrive under bright skies, with no beasts of prey and citizens joyfully speaking the king’s name.
